text: sorry no so when i said tabs at the bottom, think of it like how when you open a document in vscode, and it now is a tabbed document that is open, this is what i mean. where the main editor here is the game editor but then if i end up clicking on a model in the content browser for example, its going to open up a document basically that is the mesh editor for that model without me saying take me to a mesh editor and then im going to open this model
resolution: Corrected the bottom strip from fixed workflow modes to VS Code-style opened documents. Content-browser model cards now open/focus model document tabs automatically; saved Studio models mount the real StudioEditor, cooked model assets open a read-only source-data document, material focus opens a material document, and non-world tabs can be closed while the World Editor stays pinned.
